Losers: Nestle India (NESTLEIND) only if the order is a contribution demand, and then the cost is likely small against its profit; other FMCG names with similar PF-wage-definition disputes are not named in the filing, so none clear
Catalyst: surprise - Reg 30 intimation at 13:37 IST; matters only if the amount is material and Nestle appeals, which the headline does not say
